questions.stem: Why did you break up with John?

options.C: He had been waiting for me.

questions.explain:
break up with: 與...分手
two-time: 劈腿、對感情不忠
record-breaker: 破紀錄者
解析：題目詢問分手原因。two-timing 指劈腿或感情不忠，符合分手的合理理由，故答案選A。B選項是利用 break 衍生的 record-breaker 設下字面陷阱；C選項等候我與D選項為我著迷，語意皆不符分手的情境邏輯。

questions.stem: You seem to be lost. Need help?

options.D: Yes, I'm looking for the exit.

questions.explain:
be lost: 迷路
look for: 尋找
exit: 出口
解析：題意為「你看起來迷路了，需要幫忙嗎？」D選項回答「好啊，我在找出口」符合受助情境，故答案選D。干擾項A的 loser（失敗者）與C的 lost weight（減重）皆為同源字或字面陷阱；B未說明需求就道謝則不合對話邏輯。

questions.stem: May I speak with John, please?

options.A: Yes, you may speak your mind.
options.C: No, I did not say anything.

questions.explain:
speak with: 與...通話
This is he: 我就是本人（電話用語）
speak one's mind: 直言不諱
解析：題目為常見電話用語，意思是「請問約翰在嗎？」。若接聽者正是本人，習慣回答 This is he，故答案選B。選項A是用動詞 speak 的片語字面陷阱；選項C回答沒說話、選項D回應沒關係，皆偏離電話對話情境。

questions.stem: How did you meet your girlfriend?

options.A: Someone fixed me up with her.
options.C: She stood me up several times.

questions.explain:
fix someone up with: 替某人撮合或作媒
stand someone up: 放某人鴿子
解析：題目詢問「你是如何認識你女朋友的？」，重點在於相識的途徑。A選項表示「有人替我們牽線」，符合問句情境，故答案選A。B選項回答地點（Where）、D選項回答時間（When），皆非How的回答；C選項指被放鴿子，文意完全不符。

questions.stem: What's the time difference between Taipei and Toronto?

options.A: Taipei has a population of 2.6 million.
options.B: Toronto is a big city in Canada .
options.D: Toronto has been famous for its nightlife.

questions.explain:
time difference: 時差
ahead: （時間上）領先、提早
population: 人口
解析：題目詢問台北與多倫多之間的時差是多少。選項C指出台北快了12個小時，正確回答時差問題，因此答案選C。選項A提到人口統計，B介紹地理位置，D描述多倫多的夜生活，皆屬於答非所問的背景介紹干擾項。

questions.stem: How was your flight?
questions.explain:
flight: 班機、飛行旅程
bumpy: 顛簸的
解析：題目詢問搭機過程如何。bumpy 意為顛簸的，常用於形容飛行時遇到氣流的狀況，故答案選B。選項 A 出差、C 露營與 D 員工旅遊，都是在回答旅行的性質或目的，而非描述班機飛行時的感受。

questions.stem: Do you often skip breakfast?

options.A: No, I never make breakfast for myself.
options.B: Yes, I'm too busy in the morning.
options.C: No, I haven't had lunch yet.
options.D: Yes, breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

questions.explain:
skip breakfast: 不吃早餐、略過早餐
too busy: 太忙碌
meal: 一餐、餐點
解析：題意為「你常常不吃早餐嗎？」，skip 指略過。B 選項回答「是的，我早上太忙了」，邏輯合理，故答案選B。干擾選項中，A 說不自己做但未回答是否不吃；C 扯到 lunch（午餐）偏離主題；D 回答 Yes（常不吃）卻又稱早餐最重要，前後語意矛盾。

questions.stem: How long are you going to stay there?

options.B: It won't take long to get there.
options.D: It will take about a week.

questions.explain:
How long: 多久
That depends: 看情況、視情況而定
stay: 停留、逗留
解析：題意為「你打算在那裡待多久？」。詢問停留時間，回答「視情況而定」合乎日常對話邏輯，故答案選A。干擾選項B用get there混淆路程時間與停留時間；D的take指完成某事花費的時間而非停留；C答非所問。

questions.stem: Are you going with us?

options.A: Yes. I'm planning to go alone.
options.B: No, I don't want to be a third wheel.

questions.explain:
go with: 和...一起去
third wheel: 電燈泡、多餘的人
accept apologies: 接受道歉
解析：題意詢問「你要跟我們一起去嗎？」，答案選B。B表示拒絕並說明「不想當電燈泡」，邏輯最合理。干擾選項A前後矛盾，說好卻打算自己去；C答非所問扯到道歉；D說自己沒那麼忙卻回答不參加，語意不合邏輯。

questions.stem: Do you need a hand?

options.A: No, I can't offer any help.
options.B: Yes, I'm ready to be assistant.
options.D: Yes, I'll give you a big hand.

questions.explain:
need a hand: 需要幫忙
manage: 處理、應付
give sb a big hand: 熱烈鼓掌
解析：題目問「你需要幫忙嗎？」，主動提供協助。C表示「不用，我自己處理得來」，符合應答邏輯，故答案選C。選項A與B主客顛倒，變成回答者要去幫忙對方；D的片語意思是熱烈鼓掌，為常見的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Is it a he or a she?
questions.explain:
have no idea: 不知道
he or she: 公的還是母的
be sure: 確定
解析：題目詢問「牠是公的還是母的？」，屬於選擇疑問句，不能用 Yes 或 No 回答。當不清楚性別時回答「我不知道」最符合邏輯，故答案選B。選項A與C用Yes/No回答選擇疑問句為常見陷阱，且C的人稱代名詞they與單數主詞it不符；D反問「你確定嗎？」語意不合。

questions.stem: Where can I claim my baggage?
questions.explain:
claim baggage: 提領行李
carousel: 行李轉盤
check-in counter: 報到櫃檯
解析：題目詢問在哪裡可以提領行李。carousel為機場行李轉盤，故答案選A。選項皆為常見機場地點陷阱：B報到櫃檯是辦理登機與託運處，C登機門是上飛機地點，D免稅店為購物處，皆非領取行李的位置。

questions.stem: Where should I put some waste paper?
questions.explain:
waste paper: 廢紙
trash can: 垃圾桶
safe: 保險箱
解析：題意為「我該把廢紙放在哪裡？」廢棄物應丟進垃圾桶，故答案選C。干擾選項A冰箱、B保險箱及D銀行皆不符合常理，純粹是用不同容器或地點來混淆視聽。

questions.stem: Do I have to change planes in Hong Kong?

options.A: Yes, let's go somewhere else for a change.
options.B: No, it won't take too much time.
options.C: Yes, all plans are subject to change.
options.D: No, it'll be a direct flight.

questions.explain:
change planes: 轉機
direct flight: 直飛航班
subject to change: 可能會改變
解析：題目問「我需要在香港轉機嗎？」，不用轉機即是直飛，故答案選D。選項A利用for a change（改變一下）做字面干擾；選項C則是將planes（飛機）與發音相近的plans（計畫）混淆，皆非正解。

questions.stem: Shall we split the bill?

options.C: No, it's my treat this time.
options.D: No, it's not a cold pill.

questions.explain:
split the bill: 平攤帳單（各付各的）
it's my treat: 這次我請客
解析：題意問「我們要平攤帳單嗎？」，回絕並表示由自己買單最符合情境，答案選C。干擾選項中，A是將帳單bill誤當成人名Bill；B的spilled和D的pill則是利用發音相近所設計的典型聽力陷阱。

questions.stem: Did you check the best-before date?

options.B: Yes, I've arranged a date for you.
options.C: No, it isn't the best yet.
options.D: Yes, it says it'll expire on September 30.

questions.explain:
best-before date: 賞味期限、有效日期
expire: 到期、過期
解析：問句詢問「你確認過賞味期限了嗎？」，D選項回應「有，上面寫9月30日到期」符合語意，答案選D。干擾選項皆為一詞多義陷阱：A將check誤導為支票，B將date誤導為男女約會，C則取best字面意思，皆偏離原意。

questions.stem: What kind of beverage would you like?

options.A: I don't like to be as busy as a beaver.
options.B: I don't like to be average.
options.C: I'd like a double bed, please.

questions.explain:
beverage: 飲料
coke: 可樂
as busy as a beaver: 非常忙碌
解析：題目詢問想喝哪種飲料，coke（可樂）屬於飲料，故答案選D。選項A的beaver（海狸）與B的average（平均）皆為發音與beverage相近的聽力陷阱，選項C提到bed（床）則文不對題。

questions.stem: Did you work your way through college?

options.A: No, I rarely walked to school.
options.B: Yes, I worked part-time to pay my tuition.
options.C: No, I didn't live on campus.
options.D: Yes, I miss my school days.

questions.explain:
work one's way through college: 半工半讀讀完大學
tuition: 學費
解析：題意為「你大學是半工半讀念完的嗎？」。片語指靠自己打工賺學費與生活費完成學業，故答案選B。選項A是利用walked與worked發音相似設下的聽力陷阱，誤導為步行上學；C與D則皆與半工半讀無關。

questions.stem: Would you like a second helping?

options.A: I don't think I need your help now.
options.B: I think I still have room for more food.
options.C: I don't think I'll have a second chance.
options.D: I think I can wait a little longer.

questions.explain:
second helping: 第二份食物、再來一份
have room for: 還吃得下、有容納空間
解析：題意為「你想再來一份嗎？」，helping在此指食物分量，故答案選B「我想我還吃得下」。選項A為字面陷阱，將helping誤當成help（幫忙）；選項C則被second誤導為第二次機會，皆非用餐情境的回覆。

questions.stem: Does the iPad carry a guarantee?

options.A: Yes, they offer a one-year warranty.
options.B: No, they won't give it a try.
options.D: No, the price is not reasonable.

questions.explain:
carry a guarantee: 附有保固
warranty: 保固
rechargeable: 可充電的
解析：題目詢問這台iPad是否有保固。guarantee與warranty為同義詞，均指保固，故答案選A。選項B（嘗試）、C（電池可充電）與D（價格合理性）皆答非所問，偏離保固主題。

questions.stem: Do you have a reservation?

options.A: Yes, I had a conversation with him.
options.B: No, I haven't got any information.
options.C: Yes, I booked a table for four.
options.D: No, I don't care about my reputation.

questions.explain:
reservation: 預約、訂位
book a table: 預訂位子
解析：題目詢問「你有預約嗎？」，常用於餐廳或飯店。C選項的book代表預訂，回答訂了四人位，符合情境，故答案選C。A選項的conversation（對話）、B選項的information（資訊）及D選項的reputation（名譽），皆為尾音-tion的押韻聽力陷阱，文意完全無關。

questions.stem: What was your childhood like?

options.A: My children are the center of my life.
options.B: I had a very strict upbringing.
options.C: They all had a happy childhood.
options.D: I told them bedtime stories every night.

questions.explain:
childhood: 童年
upbringing: 養育、家教
strict: 嚴格的
解析：題目詢問「你的童年過得如何？」，答案選B（我受到的家教非常嚴格）切合對自身成長背景的描述。干擾選項A與D利用 children 設下字面陷阱，答非所問地提及自己養育小孩的狀況；選項C的主詞 They 則與問句詢問的 your 不符。

questions.stem: Do you have a minute?

options.C: Yes, I need to take a few minutes' break.
options.D: Sorry, I forgot to wear my watch.

questions.explain:
Do you have a minute?: 你有空嗎？
What's up?: 怎麼了？
take a break: 休息
解析：Do you have a minute? 用於詢問對方「現在是否有空講話」，A回答「當然，怎麼了？」最合適，故答案選A。選項B、C、D皆為字面陷阱，將minute誤解為遲到、休息幾分鐘或看手錶時間。

questions.stem: Why was there an ambulance outside?

options.A: One of our neighbors had a stroke.
options.C: One of our colleagues was fired.

questions.explain:
ambulance: 救護車
have a stroke: 中風
colleague: 同事
解析：題目詢問外面為何有救護車。A表示鄰居中風，屬於需要緊急送醫的突發狀況，符合提問因果，故答案選A。干擾項B下大雨、C同事被解僱及D免費外送，均與救護車的情境完全無關，屬於不合生活邏輯的語意陷阱。

questions.stem: Why did you drop out of the game?

options.A: I like to play video games.
options.D: The game was at its height.

questions.explain:
drop out of: 退出
pull a muscle: 肌肉拉傷
at its height: 在頂峰、最熱烈時
解析：題目問「你為什麼退出比賽？」，選項C「我肌肉拉傷了」合理說明退賽原因，故答案選C。選項A、B答非所問，D指比賽正精采，皆重複使用game製造字面干擾，未能回答退賽理由。

questions.stem: They may give away our plans.
questions.explain:
give away: 洩漏，透露
reveal: 揭露，洩漏
obstruct: 阻礙，妨礙
解析：題意為「他們可能會洩漏我們的計畫」。片語 give away 在此指洩漏情報或機密，同義詞為 reveal，故答案選D。干擾選項A（反對）、B（支持）與C（阻撓）皆為行動上的對抗或協助，非洩漏之意，屬於常見的詞義混淆陷阱。

questions.stem: The jury were unanimous in their decision.

options.A: They had difficulty reaching a decision.
options.B: They had disagreements about their decision.
options.C: They were in complete agreement when reaching the decision.
options.D: They were ready to announce their decision.

questions.explain:
jury: 陪審團
unanimous: 全體一致的
complete agreement: 完全同意
解析：題意為陪審團的決定是一致的。單字 unanimous 指意見完全一致，與 in complete agreement 意思相同，故答案選C。干擾項A的「難以決定」與B的「產生分歧」皆與題意相反；D選項指「準備宣布」則未切中核心語意。

questions.stem: The president of Egypt has stepped down.

options.A: The president of Egypt has resigned.
options.B: The president of Egypt has disappeared.
options.C: The president of Egypt has retired.
options.D: The president of Egypt has escaped.

questions.explain:
step down: 辭職、下台
resign: 辭職
retire: 退休
解析：題意為埃及總統已經下台。片語 step down 意為「辭職、退位」，與 resign 同義，因此答案選A。主要干擾選項C是退休，通常指年齡屆滿離職；B消失與D逃跑則是字面混淆，與政治下台無關。

questions.stem: An overdose of sleeping pills can be lethal.

options.C: Taking too many sleeping pills can cause death.
options.D: Taking some sleeping pills can improve your sleep quality.

questions.explain:
overdose: 服藥過量
lethal: 致命的
sleeping pill: 安眠藥
解析：題意為「服用過量安眠藥可能是致命的」。overdose 指吃太多（taking too many），lethal 表示致命、會致死（cause death），故答案選C。選項A與B中的 legal（合法）是利用與 lethal 發音相近的聽力干擾陷阱；D 則完全偏離句意。

questions.stem: Hemingway was a prolific writer.

options.A: Hemingway wrote a lot of books.
options.C: Heming way wrote a few political novels.

questions.explain:
prolific: 多產的
professional: 專業的
political: 政治的
解析：題幹表示海明威是位多產的作家。prolific 意思是多產的、產量豐富的，代表寫了許多書，故答案選A。干擾選項B舉世聞名不等於多產；選項C的 a few 與題意相反；選項D則是用字首拼法和發音相近的 professional 設下字面陷阱。

questions.stem: It's a hybrid car.

options.B: It uses both gas and electricity for power.

questions.explain:
hybrid car: 油電混合車
electricity: 電力
solar energy: 太陽能
解析：題意為「這是一輛油電混合車」。hybrid 指混合兩種動力，即同時使用汽油與電力運作，故答案選B。選項A全新車與C賽車皆偏離字義，選項D的太陽能則是替換成錯誤動力的干擾項。

questions.stem: You should weigh your words.

options.C: You should think carefully before speaking.
options.D: You should check with your dictionary.

questions.explain:
weigh one's words: 斟酌字句、深思熟慮
wait and see: 靜觀其變
解析：題意為「你說話應當斟酌字句」，意指說話前要仔細思考，故答案選C。A選項利用weigh與wait發音相近設下聽力陷阱；B誤解為完全不說話；D則將words字面聯想到查字典，皆非原意。

questions.stem: Either you or I have to give a briefing.

options.A: Neither of us has to give a briefing.
options.B: One of us has to give a briefing.
options.C: Both of us have to go to a briefing.
options.D: One of us has to go to a briefing.

questions.explain:
either... or...: 不是…就是…（兩者之一）
give a briefing: 進行簡報
解析：題意為「不是你就是我必須做簡報」，代表兩人中有一人要做，故答案選B。干擾選項A的Neither指兩者都不；C的Both指兩人都要；D則是把動詞give（報告）換成go to（去參加），皆與原意不符。

questions.stem: The hurricane is gaining momentum.

options.A: The hurricane is heading in our direction.

questions.explain:
hurricane: 颶風
gain momentum: 獲得動力、加快速度
slow down: 減速
解析：題意為「颶風正獲得動量」。gain momentum 指動能或衝力增加、速度變快，故答案選D。C 選項「減速」與題意恰好相反；A 與 B 選項僅提到移動方向或即將來臨，屬於過度推論的干擾選項。

questions.stem: The supermarket is open around the clock.

options.C: It is open 24 hours a day.

questions.explain:
around the clock: 晝夜不停、24小時全天候
open: 營業中的
解析：題意指這家超市全天候營業。片語 around the clock 表示晝夜不停、24小時營業，因此答案選C。選項 A 刻意使用原句的 around 與 clock 設下字面陷阱；選項 B 與 D 提到超市會關門打烊，皆與全天候營業的意思相悖。

questions.stem: I'm no big fan of basketball.

options.A: I'm too short to play basketball.
options.C: I'm too busy to play basketball.

questions.explain:
be no big fan of: 對...不感興趣
be interested in: 對...有興趣
be good at: 擅長於
解析：題幹表示「我不是個籃球迷」，意即對籃球沒興趣，故答案選B。片語 not a fan of 表「不喜歡」，干擾選項A（太矮）、C（太忙）、D（不擅長）皆為過度推論的藉口陷阱，原句僅單純表達個人喜好，與身高限制、時間忙碌或打球技術好壞完全無關。

questions.stem: Your motorcycle needs to be maintained.

options.A: Your motorcycle needs to be insured.
options.B: Your motorcycle needs to be warmed up.
options.C: Your motorcycle needs to be registered.
options.D: Your motorcycle needs to be serviced.

questions.explain:
maintain: 維護、保養
service: 檢修、保養
insure: 投保
解析：題意為「你的機車需要保養」。maintain 與 service 皆指車輛的定期維修保養，意思相同，故答案選D。選項A（投保）、B（熱車）、C（登記註冊）雖是養車的相關動作，但並非 maintain 的同義詞，屬於情境干擾。

questions.stem: This painting is a forgery.
questions.explain:
forgery: 偽造品、贗品
fake: 假貨、仿冒品
masterpiece: 傑作、名作
解析：題幹意為「這幅畫是贗品」。名詞 forgery 與 fake 為同義詞，皆指偽造品，故答案選A。選項B（很有價值）與C（傑作）語意與贗品完全相反，選項D（抽象的）則與題意無關，皆為語意干擾項。

questions.stem: The media can make or break a politician.

options.A: The media can change a politician's behavior.
options.B: The media can promote or destroy a politician's career.
options.C: The media can help realize a politician's dreams.
options.D: The media can influence a politician's view.

questions.explain:
make or break: 決定成敗、使成功或毀滅
politician: 政治人物、政客
解析：題意為「媒體能成就或毀滅一個政治人物」。片語 make or break 指成敗關鍵，完美對應選項 B 的 promote or destroy，故答案選B。選項 A、C、D 僅片面提到改變行為、實現夢想或影響觀點，屬於字面過度延伸的干擾項，皆未能表達出原句「成就或毀滅」的對立含意。

questions.stem: You've opened a can of worms.

options.B: You'll have to bring your fishing gear.
options.C: You've created a lot of problems.
options.D: You've created a lot of opportunities.

questions.explain:
open a can of worms: 引起一連串麻煩
fishing gear: 釣魚用具
解析：題幹片語 open a can of worms 意為「引發棘手問題」，故答案選C。選項A的開罐器與選項B的釣具都是針對 can 與 worms 設下的字面陷阱；選項D則是將麻煩誤解為機會，意思完全相反。

questions.stem: They are using cutting-edge weapons.

options.B: They are using very advanced weapons.

questions.explain:
cutting-edge: 尖端的、最先進的
advanced: 先進的
解析：題意為「他們正使用尖端武器」。cutting-edge 表最先進的技術，同義於 very advanced，故答案選B。干擾項 A 的 conventional（常規的）、C 的 automatic（自動的）與 D 的 chemical（化學的）皆為其他武器種類，非尖端之意。

questions.stem: They hired the woman on the spot.
questions.explain:
hire: 僱用
on the spot: 當場、立刻
employ: 僱用、任用
解析：題意為「他們當場錄取了那位女士」。hire 與 employ 同義，on the spot 意為 immediately（立刻），故答案選A。選項B的 fired（解雇）與 hired 發音相近且語意相反，為聽力常見的混淆陷阱；選項C與D則與句意完全無關。

questions.stem: My grandmother is hard of hearing.
questions.explain:
hard of hearing: 重聽、聽力不好
partially deaf: 部分失聰、輕微耳聾
stubborn: 固執的
解析：題目中 hard of hearing 為固定片語，表示「重聽、聽力障礙」，故答案選C。選項B的 stubborn（固執）是常見陷阱，誤將聽不清楚引申為聽不進他人勸告；選項A（健康）與D（逐漸康復）則與聽力受損無關。

questions.stem: You are supposed to be present at the meeting.

options.A: You should give presents at the meeting.
options.B: You should call the meeting to order now.
options.C: You should preside over the meeting.

questions.explain:
be supposed to: 應該
be present at: 出席
attend: 參加、出席
解析：題意為「你應該出席這場會議」。be supposed to 等同 should，be present at 意同 attend，故答案選D。干擾項A利用同形字 presents（禮物）製造字面陷阱；選項B為宣佈開會；選項C為主持會議，皆偏離原意。

questions.stem: I'm having butterflies in my stomach.

options.D: I have a lot of air in my stomach.

questions.explain:
butterflies in one's stomach: 感到緊張不安
nervous: 緊張的
解析：題意為「我非常緊張」。「have butterflies in one's stomach」是常見慣用語，形容因緊張而忐忑不安，故答案選B。選項A生病、C胃痛與D胃脹氣，都是由題目中的 stomach（胃）所衍生的字面陷阱，並非該片語的原意。

questions.stem: The movie has an excellent cast.

options.A: The movie has very good soundtracks.
options.B: The movie has very good special effects.
options.C: The movie has very good costumes.
options.D: The movie has very good actors.

questions.explain:
cast: 演員陣容
soundtrack: 電影配樂
special effects: 特效
解析：題意為這部電影有優秀的演員陣容。cast 指電影或戲劇的「全體演員」，與 actors 同義，故答案選D。選項 A 配樂、B 特效與 C 服裝雖皆為電影製作常見項目，但非 cast 的字義，為情境主題干擾選項。

questions.stem: My younger sister was scared to death.
questions.explain:
scared to death: 嚇得要命、非常害怕
frightened: 害怕的、受驚嚇的
break into tears: 突然大哭
解析：題意為「我妹妹嚇得要命」。scared to death 為誇飾法，指極度恐懼，與 very frightened 同義，故答案選A。選項 B 是受到 death 誤導的字面陷阱，並非真有生命危險；C 指健康差；D 則是過度推論為快哭了，皆不符原意。

questions.stem: The headache he had was imaginary.

options.B: His headache was a symptom of some disease.
options.D: His headache was caused by insomnia.

questions.explain:
headache: 頭痛
imaginary: 想像的、虛構的
symptom: 症狀
解析：題意指「他的頭痛是想像出來的」。imaginary 表示虛構、非真實，與 not real 意思相同，故答案選C。干擾項 A（嚴重）、B（疾病症狀）與 D（失眠引起）都誤把頭痛當作真實存在的病況，屬於過度推論病因的干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: I'll bet my bottom dollar that he'll come.

options.A: I'm very sure that he'll come.
options.B: I'm not sure whether he'll come.
options.C: I'm very sure he won't be able to come.
options.D: I'm not sure when he'll come.

questions.explain:
bet one's bottom dollar: 敢打包票、極為肯定
be sure: 確信、有把握
解析：題意為「我敢打包票他一定會來」。片語 bet one's bottom dollar 表示對某事極有把握、百分之百確信，因此答案選A。選項B與D使用 not sure（不確定），選項C則是否定句 won't come（不會來），皆與原意完全相反，屬於常見的反義干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Their service leaves nothing to be desired.

options.C: Their service is free of charge.

questions.explain:
leave nothing to be desired: 完美無缺、無可挑剔
satisfactory: 令人滿意的
erratic: 不穩定的、忽好忽壞的
解析：題幹表示「他們的服務好到無可挑剔」，leave nothing to be desired 為固定片語表示極為完美，故答案選B。選項A為主要字面陷阱，容易因看到 nothing 而誤判為服務很差；選項C（免費）與D（不穩定）皆與題意無關。

questions.stem: M: Before you sign the lease, do you have any questions? W: Yes. Does the rent include utilities? Q: What is the woman doing?

turns.t: Before you sign the lease, do you have any questions?
Yes. Does the rent include utilities?
What is the woman doing?

questions.explain:
sign the lease: 簽署租約
rent: 租金
utilities: 水電雜費
解析：男士詢問簽約前有無疑問，女士詢問租金是否包含水電費，由關鍵字可推知女士正在租屋，故答案選A。選項B賣家具、C買保險、D做家事，皆與簽租約的核心情境無關，為無關干擾項。

questions.stem: M: Should we take the subway or a taxi to the airport? W: Let's take a taxi. My suitcase is too bulky to carry around. Q: Why does the woman suggest taking a taxi?

options.A: Taking a taxi will save more time.
options.B: Her suitcase is large and heavy.
options.C: The taxi driver will offer some help.
options.D: The airport is crowded with people.

turns.t: Should we take the subway or a taxi to the airport?
Let's take a taxi. My suitcase is too bulky to carry around.
Why does the woman suggest taking a taxi?

questions.explain:
bulky: 龐大笨重的
suitcase: 行李箱
carry around: 到處攜帶
解析：女士說明搭計程車是因為行李太笨重（bulky）不好到處提。選項B的 large and heavy 為 bulky 的同義替換，故答案選B。選項A節省時間、C司機會幫忙與D機場擁擠，皆為題幹未提及的常識干擾選項，切勿自行過度推論。

questions.stem: W: You look very handsome in your cap and gown. M: Thanks, sis. You'll be going to college soon. Q: Why is the man wearing a cap and gown?

options.A: He is participating in some contest.
options.B: He is participating in a cosplay event.
options.C: He is going to play baseball.
options.D: He is going to graduate from college.

turns.t: You look very handsome in your cap and gown.
Thanks, sis. You'll be going to college soon.
Why is the man wearing a cap and gown?

questions.explain:
cap and gown: 學士服與方帽
graduate from: 從...畢業
participate in: 參加
解析：對話中女士稱讚男士穿著學士服帽（cap and gown）很帥，男士也提到妹妹很快要上大學，可推知男士正要大學畢業，答案選D。選項A的比賽、B的角色扮演及C的打棒球皆與畢業情境無關，屬於字面過度聯想的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: What do you think of Jenny's boyfriend? M: He is a bore. Q: What does the man mean?

options.A: Jenny's boyfriend is an intelligent person.
options.B: Jenny's boyfriend is a reliable person.
options.C: Jenny's boyfriend is an uninteresting person.
options.D: Jenny's boyfriend is a nice person.

turns.t: What do you think of Jenny's boyfriend?
He is a bore.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
bore: 無趣的人、討厭的人
uninteresting: 無趣的、乏味的
解析：女士詢問對珍妮男友的看法，男士回答He is a bore。名詞bore指令人厭煩或無趣的人，與uninteresting同義，故答案選C。選項A聰明的、B可靠的、D人很好皆為正面評價，與男士的負面批評完全相反，為主要干擾選項。

questions.stem: M: What time is it now? W: It's a quarter of three. Q: What time is it now?

turns.t: What time is it now?
It's a quarter of three.
What time is it now?

questions.explain:
quarter: 十五分鐘（一刻）
a quarter of: 差十五分鐘到
解析：題目詢問現在時間。a quarter of 表示差十五分鐘到整點，three 是三點，因此 a quarter of three 是差十五分三點，即2:45，答案選B。選項A(3:15)與C(3:45)是將 of 誤解或混淆為 past/after（過了一刻）的常見時間陷阱。

questions.stem: W: Let me check the doctor's schedule. Well, how about Friday afternoon at 2:30? M: OK, that'll be fine with me. Q: What is the man doing?

options.A: Asking the woman out for a date.
options.D: Paying a fine to the court.

turns.t: Let me check the doctor's schedule. Well, how about Friday afternoon at 2:30?
OK, that'll be fine with me.
What is the man doing?

questions.explain:
schedule: 時間表、日程
make an appointment: 預約、掛號
解析：女士替醫生確認時間，男士同意此安排，可知男士正在預約看診，答案選B。干擾項A誤將看診當成男女約會；D利用對話中的fine（好的）混淆成名詞「罰款」的字面陷阱；C給予指示則與情境完全不符。

questions.stem: W: Would you like to try your luck in Las Vegas? M: Of course. I can't wait to hit the jackpot. Q: Where will the man go in Las Vegas?

turns.t: Would you like to try your luck in Las Vegas?
Of course. I can't wait to hit the jackpot.
Where will the man go in Las Vegas?

questions.explain:
try your luck: 碰運氣
hit the jackpot: 中大獎
casino: 賭場
解析：男士說迫不及待想「中大獎」並在賭城「試手氣」，顯然指的是去賭博，故答案選D。選項A夜店、B魔術秀與C餐廳雖都是拉斯維加斯常見的休閒娛樂，但皆無法對應贏得博弈頭獎的情境。

questions.stem: W: The bride and the groom look very happy. M: Let's raise our glasses to them. W: OK. Q: What are the man and the woman going to do?

options.A: Put on their glasses to see better.
options.C: Drink a toast to the bride and the groom.

turns.t: The bride and the groom look very happy.
Let's raise our glasses to them.
OK.
What are the man and the woman going to do?

questions.explain:
bride and groom: 新娘與新郎
raise one's glass: 舉杯祝賀
drink a toast: 舉杯敬酒
解析：男士提議向新人舉杯，意思即為敬酒祝賀，故答案選C。選項A將酒杯glasses誤解為近視眼鏡，屬於一字多義的字面陷阱；選項B則將raise（舉起）混淆為raise money（募款）。

questions.stem: W: Why are you crying? Has anything happened? M: My father passed away this morning. Q: What happened to the woman?

options.C: Her father walked out on them.
options.D: Her father vanished without a trace.

turns.t: Why are you crying? Has anything happened?
My father passed away this morning.
What happened to the woman?

questions.explain:
pass away: 去世，過世
walk out on: 拋棄，離棄
解析：對話中 passed away 為 died 的委婉說法，表示父親已過世，因此答案選A。選項B意為重病但未過世；選項C為拋棄家庭離去；選項D為離奇失蹤，皆與事實不符，純屬字面與情境干擾。

questions.stem: M: How time flies! W: Yeah. New Year is around the corner. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.C: New Year is still far away.
options.D: She wants to make some New Year's resolutions.

turns.t: How time flies!
Yeah. New Year is around the corner.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
How time flies: 光陰似箭
around the corner: 即將來臨
解析：女士說 New Year is around the corner，片語 around the corner 代表即將來臨，故答案選A。選項C說還很遙遠，意思完全相反；選項B最喜歡新年與選項D想做新年新希望在對話中皆未提及，屬於過度引申的干擾選項。

questions.stem: ______ most people know, Nashville, Tennesse, is the home of country music.
questions.explain: as表如同, 如眾所皆知的

questions.stem: The loud music from my next-door neighbor is driving me ______.
questions.explain: drive someone nuts（mad/crazy） 讓某人火大

questions.stem: Jogging may be good for your health, but swimming is ______ better.
questions.explain: even better更好,慢跑對健康有益但游泳更甚於慢跑

questions.stem: Make one more mistake, ______ you are fired.
questions.explain: 用and表示話沒講完,你再犯錯就直接開除了

questions.stem: The coffee you brewed tastes really good . I'd like to get a ______.
questions.explain: 單字題refill續杯

questions.stem: I fully enjoyed the high speed of the roller coaster______.
questions.explain: from start to finish從頭到尾

questions.stem: ______ I'm late, start the dinner party without me.
questions.explain: in case是萬一,萬一我遲到,你們就開始晚宴,不必等我

questions.stem: It is a one-stop shopping mall. You can ______ whatever you want there.
questions.explain:
pick up撿起,收集,用少數的錢買到,用（車）來接,one-stop shopping是大型量
販店

questions.stem: To tell you the truth, my sole hobby is ______ stamps and coins.
questions.explain: 收集郵票和錢幣是動詞當名詞用,故collect 要+ing

questions.stem: Most of the ______around the world feed on gossip and scandals.
questions.explain: tabloids是八卦小報

questions.stem: Although Jerry and I ______ co-workers for years, we do not get along.
questions.explain:
for + 一段時間句型使用現在完成式,表某段時間到現在我和Jerry雖然共事好多
年還是處不來

questions.stem: It's your sister's wedding. You should ______for the occasion.
questions.explain: dress up為盛裝打扮之意

questions.stem: If you are worried about coming down with the flu, ______vaccinated as soon as possible.
questions.explain: get vaccinated要人去打疫苗是祈使句或命令句,需使用原形

questions.stem: Wait a minute! Who do you think ______?
questions.explain: who do you think後接子句,你以為你是誰？

questions.stem: Lisa is very selfish. That's ______ I don't like about her.
questions.explain: Lisa很自私,這就是我不喜歡她的地方,what表示selfish

questions.stem: Diana's image as a charity icon has remained intact ______ she died.
questions.explain: since + 一個時間點的句型使用現在完成式; 自那時到現在

questions.stem: ______ we have time to go grab a bite before the movie?
questions.explain: 主要動詞have的問句需使用助動詞do,看電影前我們有時間簡單吃點東⻄嗎？

questions.stem: It did not ______ to me that my cousin was the thief.
questions.explain: occur to浮現;從沒想過我表哥就是那個小偷

questions.stem: Judging from this picture, your father ______ very rich when young.
questions.explain:
從這張照片看來你父親一定以前就很有錢了,用現在完成式表達從以前到現在
就是有錢人

questions.stem: The passengers came to realize that the plane was losing ______ very quickly.
questions.explain: altitude是高度,乘客領悟到飛機很快失去重心了

questions.stem: They had ______ walked for five minutes when they spotted a bus stop.
questions.explain: hardly幾乎不,當他們找到巴士站牌時幾乎連要走五分鐘都走不了了

questions.stem: I hate ______when I have to get out of bed very early on a cold morning.
questions.explain: it表示後者這件事;若為that,後面不接句子

questions.stem: Ralph is packing his snorkeling ______ for the trip to the beach.
questions.explain: gear為用具,snorkeling浮潛

questions.stem: ______ to my disappointment, the guest I was expecting did not show up.
questions.explain: much形容名詞disappointment表很失望

questions.stem: The king has three daughters. He said you may marry______you like.
questions.explain: 三個中任何一個用which表任一個

questions.stem: According to the study, such chemicals in the air will ______ harm to the ozone layer.
questions.explain: do harm是造成傷害　harm之前動詞需使用do

questions.stem: The officer said to me, "Can you stand ______ one leg?
questions.explain: stand on one leg用一隻腳站立

questions.stem: Not knowing ______, Tom turned to his friends for help.
questions.explain: not know what to do是不知道做什麼好;而非怎麼做;句首動詞+ing

questions.stem: George demanded that Mary______ back all the money she had taken from him.
questions.explain: demand要求他人做的事使用原形,與suggest,　recommend的用法相同

questions.stem: ______was the popularity of the opera that the theater was full every night.
questions.explain:
such + N. … that…歌劇如此受歡迎到每晚都爆滿，such後接名詞
popularity；so + adj.形容詞

questions.stem: My younger brother and I go hiking every Sundy morning, rain or ______.
questions.explain: rain or shine不論晴天或雨天

questions.stem: Helen is too young to travel to Europe______.
questions.explain: travel alone單獨旅行,用alone副詞形容動詞travel

questions.stem: All the players were very confident of winning the game. The coach was not so sure, ______.
questions.explain: though不過,可放句尾要加逗點,所有選手都有信心會贏但教練可沒把握

questions.stem: We spent a whole day ______art galleries and antique shops in Mumbai.
questions.explain: spend後面動詞要+ ing,　花一整天在參觀美術館和骨董店

questions.stem: The cause of the ______was due to the taxi driver's careless driving.
questions.explain: collision撞擊,車子相撞起因於計程車司機的不小心

questions.stem: The ancient Greeks thought all the forces of nature were spirits. Therefore, the whole earth was filled with gods and goddesses. Each woodland, and even each great tree had its own god, not to mention the sun or the moon. What is the passage about?
questions.explain:
mythology: 神話
goddess: 女神
not to mention: 更不用說
解析：本段描述古希臘人深信自然界充滿神祇與女神，主題與神靈信仰有關，故答案選A。選項B（哲學）、C（醫學）與D（政治）雖同為古希臘文明知名領域，但文中完全未提及思辨、醫療或政制，為概念偏離的干擾項。

questions.stem: During the second half of 2010, the price of corn rose sharply-73 percent in the United States. Most researchers attributed the soaring price to the greater use of American corn for making biofuel. What did the price of corn rise so sharply in the United States?

options.C: Because demand for corn as food was increasing.
options.D: Because more and more corn was used to make fuel.

questions.explain:
attribute to: 歸因於
soaring: 暴漲的
biofuel: 生質燃料
解析：題幹問玉米價格急升的原因。文中指出研究員將暴漲歸因於更多玉米被用於製造生質燃料，故答案選D。選項A歉收與B天災為常識陷阱但在文中未提及，選項C指糧食需求增加則與製造燃料的文意不符。

questions.stem: Some people eat mostly fast food. One study shows that most fast-food eaters have a lot in common. They are competitive and good at business. They are also usually in a hurry. Many fast-food eaters might not agree with this description of their personalities, but it is a common picture of them. Which of the following is a trait of fast-food eaters?

options.B: They are often on the go.
options.C: They tend to disagree with each other.

questions.explain:
in a hurry: 匆忙
on the go: 忙碌奔波
trait: 特徵
解析：題幹詢問速食族特徵。文中指出 usually in a hurry 與 on the go 同義，故答案選B。干擾選項A將 competitive 混淆為保守；C扭曲不同意該描述為彼此不合；D則是把 picture（寫照）字面誤解為拍照的陷阱。

questions.stem: Dentists think that women can put up with more pain than men. Michael is a dentist and he says, "Women are more aware of what pain is than a man." Men do not seem to expect any pain and are surprised when the drilling hurts. Pain researchers think that men aren't prepared for pain. What can be implied from the passage?

options.A: Women can endure pain better than men.
options.B: Most dentists around the world are male.
options.C: Men are always ready to endure pain.
options.D: Female dentists are more welcome than male ones.

questions.explain:
put up with: 忍受
endure: 忍受、忍耐
aware: 意識到的
解析：題意問短文推論。首句指出女性比男性更能忍痛，put up with與A選項的endure同義，故答案選A。干擾項C說男性總是準備好忍痛，與文中說男性未準備好相反；B與D提到牙醫的性別比例與受歡迎程度，文中均未提及。

questions.stem: Global warming is not all bad for farming. For instance, in some parts of Siberia or northern Canada, increased temperature tends to lengthen the growing season with the possibility of growing a greater variety of crops in these regions. What is the main idea of this passage?

options.A: Global warming is good for nothing.
options.B: Global warming is growing more serious.
options.C: Global warming has some positive impacts.
options.D: Global warming has many bad influences.

questions.explain:
global warming: 全球暖化
lengthen: 延長
crop: 農作物
解析：本題問主旨。文章開頭指出全球暖化對農業不全是壞事，並舉例氣溫升高能延長生長季，說明其帶有正面效益，故答案選C。干擾項A「一無是處」與D「許多壞影響」皆與正面論述相反，為常見字意陷阱；B「暖化日益嚴重」則非本文重點。
